title: NASA Uranus satellite sheet: Oberon (UIV) mass 28.8×10^20 kg, radius 761.4 km
summary: The Uranus satellite fact sheet lists Oberon (UIV) at mass 28.8 × 10^20 kg and radius 761.4 km.
body: NASA's Uranus satellite fact sheet lists Oberon (UIV) with mass 28.8 × 10^20 kg, radius 761.4 km, mean density 1,560 kg/m^3, and visual geometric albedo 0.23. Orbital parameters on the same sheet: Semi-major axis (10 3 km) = 583.50; Semi-major axis (Uranian Radii) = 22.83; Orbital Period * (days) = 13.463234; Rotation Period (days) = S; Inclination (degrees) = 0.07; Eccentricity = 0.0014. These are the cells printed on the sheet. The sheet does not say, on this row, which cells are a spacecraft measurement and which are an estimate. The sheet says R indicates retrograde motion, and S indicates synchronous rotation, the rotation period equal to the orbital period. Author of the sheet: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Last Updated line: 11 March 2023.
